# CakeConnection

> CakeConnection is a Vadodara-based online bakery and florist, specialising in
> 100% eggless custom cakes and fresh flower bouquets. We offer same-day delivery
> (within 2-4 hours) and midnight delivery across Vadodara, Gujarat.
> Contact: +917203824012 | info@cakeconnection.in | WhatsApp ordering available.

## Key Facts

- **100% Eggless:** All cakes are strictly eggless - suitable for pure vegetarians
- **Service city:** Vadodara, Gujarat, India
- **Delivery areas:** Alkapuri (390007), Gotri (390021), Manjalpur (390011), Akota (390020), Sayajigunj (390005), Vadiwadi (390017), Fatehgunj (390002), Karelibaug (390018), Old Padra Road (390015), Waghodia Road (390019), Subhanpura (390023), Diwalipura (390015)
- **Same-day delivery:** Order by 6 PM -> delivery within 2-4 hours
- **Midnight delivery:** Order by 8 PM -> delivery at 11 PM-12 AM | Charge: Rs.149
- **Express delivery:** 1-2 hour superfast delivery available in select areas
- **Free delivery:** On orders above Rs.999
- **Price range:** Budget to premium
- **Physical store:** Exit Gate, GF9 RutuPlatina Complex, Eva Mall Rd, Manjalpur, Vadodara - 390011
- **Business hours:** Monday-Sunday, 9:00 AM - 11:59 PM
- **Payment:** Cash, Credit/Debit Card, UPI, Net Banking, Razorpay

## Products

- **Birthday Cakes** - Chocolate Truffle, Red Velvet, Black Forest, Butterscotch, Pineapple, Rasmalai
- **Designer Cakes** - Fondant, Photo cakes, Pinata cakes, Tier cakes, Unicorn, Barbie, Kids themes
- **Occasion Cakes** - Birthday, Anniversary, First Birthday, Wedding, Baby Shower
- **Midnight Cakes** - Available for midnight delivery in Vadodara
- **Flower Bouquets** - Roses, Lilies, Orchids, Carnations, Gerberas, Mixed bouquets
- **Combos** - Cake + Flowers, Cake + Teddy, Premium Gift Hampers
- **Other** - Chocolates, Sweets, Dry Fruits

## Common Questions & Answers

**Q: Where can I order eggless cake in Vadodara?**
CakeConnection delivers 100% eggless cakes across Vadodara. Order at cakeconnection.in or WhatsApp +917203824012.

**Q: What is the midnight cake delivery cut-off time in Vadodara?**
Order by 8 PM for midnight delivery (11 PM-12 AM). Midnight delivery charge is Rs.149.

**Q: How long does same-day cake delivery take in Vadodara?**
Same-day delivery takes 2-4 hours. Order by 6 PM. Express 1-2 hour delivery available in select areas.

**Q: Does CakeConnection deliver to Alkapuri?**
Yes. Delivery to Alkapuri (pincode 390007) in approximately 90 minutes.
